defect_location.description: CVE-2019-3823: smtp_endofresp 对未 NUL 结尾且 len=5 的缓冲堆越界读（CVE 描述: heap out-of-bounds read in the code handling the end-of-response for SMTP ... if the buffer ... isn't NUL terminated and contains no character ending the parsed number）。

source.simplification: 剥离 SMTP 传输层，响应缓冲硬编码为 3 字节堆分配，保留『按固定 5 字节模式读且忽略 len』核心缺陷

trigger_condition: SMTP 响应缓冲 3 字节且无 NUL，endofresp 仍按固定 5 字节扫描
notes: CVE-2019-3823: smtp_endofresp 对未 NUL 结尾且 len=5 的缓冲堆越界读（CVE 描述: heap out-of-bounds read in the code handling the end-of-response for SMTP ... if the buffer ... isn't NUL terminated and contains no character ending the parsed number）。
